// @path: src/lib/ops/totp.ts
// @expect: OPS-IMPORT-ALLOWLIST
// PR1 put `otplib` on the ops import allowlist (owner decision D4). This is the
// near miss that widening invites: a DIFFERENT one-time-password library, which
// nobody vetted, doing the same job. Deny by default still means deny by
// default, and one reviewed entry does not open the category.
import speakeasy from "speakeasy";

export function codeFor(secret) {
  return speakeasy.totp({ secret, encoding: "base32" });
}
